history.content: Hi, my phone has no internet at all unless I'm on Wi-Fi, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help?

I can help you with this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data and MMS issues.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you, Sofia. I see your line is active. To help resolve your mobile data and picture messaging (MMS) issues, I’ll need you to perform a few quick checks on your phone.

Are you able to run diagnostic actions on your device if I guide you step by step? This will help me pinpoint the cause and provide the right solution.
Yes, I can do that. Just let me know what you want me to check first.

Great! Let’s start by checking your phone’s status bar to see if there are any obvious issues like Airplane Mode being on, no signal, or mobile data being disabled.

Please run the check_status_bar diagnostic on your phone and let me know what it shows, especially any icons or messages related to signal strength, mobile data, or Airplane Mode.
My status bar shows excellent signal, 5G, data enabled, and I'm connected to Wi-Fi (Chestnut-5G). Battery is at 87%.

Thank you for the details. Your phone has excellent signal, is on 5G, and mobile data is enabled, which is good. Since you’re connected to Wi-Fi, let’s check if mobile data works when Wi-Fi is off.

Please turn off Wi-Fi on your phone, then try to access the internet (like opening a website or app). After that, let me know if you still have no internet access when Wi-Fi is off.
Wi-Fi is now off and the phone is disconnected from any wireless network. I tried opening a website, but nothing loads at all.

Thank you for checking. Since you have excellent signal and 5G with mobile data enabled, but still no internet when Wi-Fi is off, let’s check your phone’s APN settings. Incorrect APN settings are a common cause for this issue and can also affect picture messaging (MMS).

Please run the check_apn_settings diagnostic on your phone and let me know what it shows, especially the APN name and MMSC URL (if any).
I checked the APN settings. The APN name is 'fast.telecom.net', the status says 'correct', and the MMSC URL is 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc'.

Thank you for confirming your APN settings. Both the APN name and MMSC URL appear correct, which means your phone is configured properly for mobile data and MMS.

Next, let’s check if Data Saver mode or any data restrictions might be affecting your connection. Please run the check_data_restriction_status diagnostic and let me know if Data Saver mode is ON or if there are any global background data restrictions.
I checked the data restriction status. Data Saver mode is OFF and there are no global data restrictions set.

Thank you for checking. Since Data Saver mode is off and there are no restrictions, let’s check if your phone’s mobile data is actually being used or if there’s a network issue.

Please run a speed test using the run_speed_test diagnostic on your phone and let me know the result, including whether it reports “no connection” or gives a speed rating (like poor, fair, good, excellent).
The speed test says there's no connection at all on cellular, even though it's showing 5G signal. I still can't get online or send picture messages.

Thank you for running the speed test. Since your phone shows a strong 5G signal and mobile data is enabled, but you have no cellular data connection, let’s check your SIM card status. Sometimes, a SIM card issue can cause this problem even if the signal appears strong.

Please run the check_sim_status diagnostic and let me know if your SIM status is “Active,” “Missing,” or “Locked.”
The SIM status says 'Active'.

Thank you for confirming your SIM status is Active. Since your SIM is active, you have excellent signal, correct APN settings, and no data restrictions, but still have no cellular data or MMS, let’s check one more thing: your network mode preference.

Please run the check_network_mode_preference diagnostic and let me know what network mode your phone is set to (for example, 5G, 4G, 3G, etc.).
My network mode preference is set to 4G/5G preferred.

I’ve checked your plan and data usage. You are on the Advantage 50GB plan, and you have used 50.5GB this cycle, which is over your monthly data limit of 50GB. When you exceed your data limit, your mobile data and MMS will stop working until you add more data or your billing cycle resets.

You have two options to restore your mobile data and MMS:
1. Add more data to your line (up to 2GB at $5.00 per GB).
2. Wait until your billing cycle resets on March 5th.

Would you like to add more data now? If so, please let me know how many GB (up to 2GB) you’d like to add.
I'd like to add 1GB of data, please.

1GB of data has been added to your line for $5.00, and the charge will appear on your current bill. Your mobile data and MMS should be restored shortly.

Please turn off Wi-Fi and try using mobile data and sending a picture message again. If you still have issues, let me know and I’ll help you further.

Thank you for trying again. Sometimes, after adding data or making changes to your account, your phone may need to be restarted to refresh its connection to the network.

Please reboot your device now. After it restarts, turn off Wi-Fi and try accessing the internet and sending a picture message again. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you still experience problems.
